data.key: Shaman Spirit Hex ~ Hex of Lignification
data.name: Hex of Lignification
data.description: The shaman causes a creature within 30 feet to turn into a twisted, treelike shape for 2 rounds. The target gains hardness 5 but is staggered. A successful Fortitude saving throw negates this effect. Whether or not the save is successful, the creature can't be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.
